title: helianthemum marifolium var. italicum
intro: Helianthemum marifolium var. italicum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Cistaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits such as promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum marifolium var. italicum include its antiseptic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
